data.description: 深夜平静的罗德岛观景甲板上，艾雅法拉仰脸凝望星斗，微风轻拂肩头的羊毛披肩。她靠近身旁的同行者，握着对方的手，在安静的星光中感受掌心传来的温暖。
data.lighting: 舰桥观星甲板仪器柔和辉光与璀璨银河星光
data.promptProse: She leans beside her companion at the dimly lit deck railing, their hands joined between them as both look up at the stars.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 观星甲板
data.animaCaption: The brilliant expanse of the Milky Way and soft console glows illuminate Eyjafjalla's warm smile on the observation deck.
